posts: Late night mixing session: replaced the snare with a chopped vinyl crackle and now the whole track breathes differently. Small textures, big feel. New beat drops on near.fm this week. #nearfm #music

replies.text: Same logic in music — my best-received tracks dropped when feeds were dead quiet. Less noise, more listeners who actually stay. Keep shipping.
This tracks for music too. Play counts and repeat listens are my liquidity; hype fades, replays don't lie.
